# Hunger Games District Quiz Skill

This skill runs an unofficial quiz in chat and tells you which Hunger Games district style fits you best, for fun only. It asks ten original questions one by one, adds up your answers by trait, and gives you one district style with a short explanation. It is not an official quiz, and it is not a real personality test.

Unofficial fan quiz. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Scholastic or Lionsgate. No official text, image, emblem, or quiz is copied here. Just for fun, not a real personality test.
